kind: scientific desktop workbench (official contracts; unavailable engine source)

runtime.execution: Local app/daemon and sandboxed Python/R kernels; operator browser or Windows app; remote jobs have external lifetimes.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns local project/session/workspace/package environments and ephemeral kernels; consumes Claude, MCP, SSH/Slurm, Modal and scientific HTTP model services.

summary: Versioned scientific artifacts, code execution, specialist delegation and reviewed research in a local workbench.

inspection.scope: pinned official CLI, kernel, artifact, permissions, connector, compute, model and reviewer documentation
inspection.limits: Application source unavailable; documentation snapshots captured alongside 0.1.55 artifacts need not be version-identical to every shipped build. No binary or example execution; no source tests available.

actions.name: Run Python / Run R / Run shell / Run PowerShell
actions.input: Executable code plus environment; access card grants
actions.output: Cell outputs/errors and saved artifact references; native tool wire names undisclosed
actions.lifecycle: Persistent interpreter state for Python/R; kernel expires/restarts; shell lifetime/control unspecified
actions.authority: Sandbox/project/folder/host grants; scoped standing code approval

actions.name: Save artifact / Edit content / Save / Provenance / Export Metadata
actions.output: New immutable-history version, version-bound link, code/log/environment/review tabs
actions.lifecycle: Saved versions retained; scratch files removed hours after session end; session deletion retains artifacts, project deletion removes
actions.authority: Operator/model workspace access; these are product control names, not invented public RPCs

actions.name: Delegation / Stop
actions.input: Enable independent tracks; stop current session
actions.lifecycle: Parallel tracks; no individual-track stopping contract
actions.authority: Session operator; work permitted under existing access grants

actions.name: Request review / Auto-review / Reviewer Instructions
actions.output: Finding cards/status/reasoning fed to next model response
actions.lifecycle: Runs after responses/periodically; disabling prevents new reviews but pending finish
actions.authority: Operator customizes additive criteria; model addresses or contests findings

actions.name: SSH remote job / Modal job
actions.surface: model proposal with scoped operator grants
actions.input: Script/command, host/resource/time limit and staged inputs
actions.output: Logs, outputs or remote paths; concrete provider handle API undisclosed
actions.lifecycle: Slurm/detached SSH work survives disconnect; Modal survives app close and times out externally
actions.authority: Remote work uses operator account outside local sandbox; standing remote grant allowed

actions.name: Add connector / Always allow / Ask each time / Block
actions.surface: operator connector configuration; model discovered MCP tools
actions.input: Remote SSE/HTTP URL or local program plus args/env; individual tool policy
actions.output: Discovered external tools/results; wire APIs remain unavailable
actions.lifecycle: Local connector subprocess within sandbox; configured remote service consumed
actions.authority: Custom connector organization policy and standing tool authority

actions.name: / skill / Add skill / Import from GitHub / distill workflow
actions.input: Instruction/resources or repository; session workflow description
actions.lifecycle: Task-selected or explicit loading; automatic context/activation implementation unobserved
actions.authority: Operator/custom-skill organizational policy; model can distill a workflow

actions.name: claude-science serve/open/url/status/logs/stop/update/import
actions.input: Data dir/config, build ID for update, source dir/database for import
actions.output: Daemon, login URL, JSON status, logs, atomic replacement or merged data
actions.lifecycle: One daemon per data dir; update requires restart to inhabit new build; no main/outpost handoff contract
actions.authority: Operator OS account; update/import may mutate owned app data

filesystem.detail: Read/write granted folders in place, attachment copies and artifact-version saves; scope grants are persistent.

processes.detail: Shell/PowerShell code and remote detached/Slurm work; no exposed general PTY/ongoing local-program handle protocol in inspected contracts.

code_actions.detail: Model-authored executable Python/R/shell is the analysis surface; MCP tools supplement it.

persistent_kernel.detail: Documented Python/R variables survive steps but kernel ends after about 30 minutes idle, session end or environment restart; no serialization/reconnect contract for shared external kernels.

standing_database.detail: Local memory database holds remembered facts and feeds model context; no documented generic model/program SQL interface. Scientific source connectors are distinct external databases.

workflow_programming.detail: Reusable skills and distilled workflows are written instructions; executable turn/workflow scheduling replacement is not established by those controls.

multi_model.detail: Claude model selection and safeguard-driven switching, plus distinct scientific model endpoints; independent conversational providers not established.

live_collaboration.detail: Not established in the explicitly inspected pinned official CLI, kernel, artifact, permissions, connector, compute, model and reviewer documentation; no universal absence claim.

concurrent_work.detail: Parallel delegated tracks, multiple per-session kernels, Modal/SSH job limits and remote independent lifetime.

steering_interrupt.detail: Whole-session Stop rather than individually controllable tracks; disabling auto-review leaves active/waiting reviews to finish. Remote cancellation details not exposed.

turn_redefinition.detail: Not established in the explicitly inspected pinned official CLI, kernel, artifact, permissions, connector, compute, model and reviewer documentation; no universal absence claim.

compaction.detail: Not established in the explicitly inspected pinned official CLI, kernel, artifact, permissions, connector, compute, model and reviewer documentation; no universal absence claim.

context_repair.detail: Past-session references and saved artifact-version messages can recover some evidence; scratch cleanup and no documented compaction-original lineage prevent claiming comprehensive repair.

original_audit.detail: Artifact provenance records command history/code/environment/messages, but temporary files are removed and no raw provider/process/transform IO-retention contract is exposed.

audit_query.detail: Human searchable artifacts and Provenance tabs are documented; comprehensive model/program audit query API is not exposed in inspected contracts.

hot_change.detail: Review toggles affect future/pending review behavior; skills/connectors adjustable; config.toml is startup-only and binary update inhabitation is restart.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Atomic vendor update preserves data with schema compatibility checks; no self-compile/outpost transfer, active-work quiescence or restored live-kernel guarantee.

remote_services.detail: Consumer of operator SSH/Slurm/Modal account and scientific HTTP/MCP endpoints; job survival differs from local ephemeral kernels.

self_improvement.detail: Not established in the explicitly inspected pinned official CLI, kernel, artifact, permissions, connector, compute, model and reviewer documentation; no universal absence claim.

complaints.detail: Not established in the explicitly inspected pinned official CLI, kernel, artifact, permissions, connector, compute, model and reviewer documentation; no universal absence claim.

authority.detail: Folder/network/tool/code/remote grants can stand per conversation/project/global; skip approvals and sandbox flags have documented exceptions and organizational precedence.

evaluation.detail: Reviewer compares claims to recorded work and cited material, does not rerun analyses or judge research-method choice; no source/runtime test oracle inspected.

time_order.detail: Kernel idle expiry, one-use login expiry, remote timeout bounds and pending-review activation semantics; no global causal audit clock exposed.

evidence.claim: Python/R state persists within a kernel; idle/session/environment termination boundaries; named environments and source builds.
Projects/sessions own workspaces; filesystem and code/remote permissions have standing scopes.
Plan approval, sandbox, parallel delegation with whole-session stop, local remembered facts and session/file/skill references.
Temporary scratch cleanup differs from artifact retention; saved versions and authoritative execution/provenance tabs.
Reviewer challenges recorded claims without rerunning methods; findings feed next response; changes affect future reviews while pending finish.
Daemon management, JSON status/logs/import, atomic update and restart/downgrade boundaries.
Per-data-dir app, login expiry and approval/sandbox overrides constrained by organization.
Consumer-controlled Modal account, observable bounded jobs, independent lifetime and scientific HTTP endpoints.
Existing SSH authority, Slurm or detached processes survive connection loss; timeout and output-size boundaries.
TOML configuration loaded at startup; organization precedence.
Remote/local MCP discovery and per-tool standing permission; sandboxed connector subprocesses.
Skills are instructions loaded by task or composer; create/write/upload/import and distill session workflows.
Model safeguards and operator model-switch behavior are official contracts, not engine traces.

strengths: A code-first scientific workbench with bounded persistent kernels and independently surviving remote computation.
Saved artifact versions bind messages, command log, code/environment and review, distinguishing actual execution log from generated reproduction code.
Scoped standing authority and custom scientific instructions/reviewer support sophisticated domain work.
limits: Every positive finding is a captured official contract, not traced application implementation or executed behavior.
Internal remembered-fact database is not a generic standing data service; Lecoq workflow and OpenAI4S do not establish app internals.
Kernel memory and temporary files have explicit expiration; artifact provenance does not promise Arconaut original-audit completeness.
Turn program replacement, live addressed peers, dedicated autoresearch governance and captured-state model complaints remain unestablished in inspected contracts.
arconaut_questions: How do we keep service references and resumable client work independent of local interpreter lifetime without governing shared service lifetimes?
What exact originals survive context transformations and failed attempts, beyond artifact-centered provenance?
Can both operator and model query/repair context from preserved originals and adjust reviewer/workflow behavior at our chosen turn/workflow conclusion boundary?
